answers.core: Project settings are part of the editor itself
answers.workaround:
Presets are optional, and they will accomplish the same thing as ticking certain settings on or off.

For example, a `Static Typing` preset might have a dropdown like so:

`Default`: Sets all the static typing/type safety warnings to their defaults (For most of them, it's `Ignore`)
`Warn`: Sets all the static typing/type safety warnings to `Warn`
`Enforced`: Sets all the static typing/type safety warnings to `Error`

To workaround presets, just manually set the settings yourself
